_doc: Contracts that went live AFTER the site first shipped, recorded so EVERY build has them. Written by scripts/wire-v3-live.mjs and scripts/wire-burn-vault.mjs right after the owner's signed deploys, and committed. Before this file existed those addresses reached the bundle only through build-time environment variables, so the next ordinary `npm run build` would have silently switched the V3 launch flow, staking and the burn vault back off. A VITE_* variable still overrides an entry (previews, rehearsals). null / empty = not deployed: the feature stays dark. Mainnet only — never put a testnet address here.

See docs/quainance-external-venue.md, 'After graduation — the pool route'.

forwarders._doc: QuaiForwarder: a contract whose ONLY possible action is paying one immutable destination, set at construction. It exists for in-app wallets that can call a contract but cannot make a plain value transfer. Deployed 2026-09-19. The destination is NOT recorded here on purpose — it is a private individual's address, this file is public, and the UI reads the destination back off the chain and shows it before anyone sends. Do not add a destination or an owner name to this entry.

relays._doc: QuaiRelay: forwards exactly msg.value to the recipient NAMED IN THE CALL, in the same transaction. The general form of the forwarder above, and the one /blipsend offers publicly — a fixed-destination contract on a public page is a one-click send to a stranger's wallet. Stateless: no owner, no admin, no fee, no setter, no storage, no receive(). Deployed 2026-09-19, 600-byte runtime. Source at /blipsend-source/QuaiRelay.sol.txt.
